definition: תִּפְסַח proper name, of a location on Euphrates (probably ford (though Lag BN 131 doubts ); Lewy Fremdw. 146 compare Αάμψακος (on Bosphorus), explanation as לַפֶּסַח ); — 1Kgs 5:4 , northeast limit of Solomon's dominion; = Gk Θάψακος Xen Anab. i. 4 etc .; identification with Kal' at Dibse , at the great easterly bend of the river, approximately Latitude 35° 55' north, Longitude 38° 20' east, JPPeters Nation, May 23, 1889: Nippur i.96 ff .
